title: Unconscious hypo, no IV
caption:
Unconscious hypoglycaemia with no IV access: IM glucagon 1 mg. Never oral glucose to someone who can't protect their airway.

Save it.

#EMREE #hypoglycemia #emergencymedicine #medicalinterns #UAEdoctors

fact.claim: Adult hypoglycaemia, unconscious, no IV access: glucagon 1 mg IM; no oral glucose if unable to swallow safely
fact.check: JBDS-IP hypoglycaemia guideline (latest) or ADA Standards of Care 2026
fact.verified: JBDS-IP Hospital management of hypoglycaemia in adults (via NHS Scotland CEM summary): glucagon 1 mg IM if unconscious/NBM. Checked 18 Nov 2026.
